title: Senior Frontend Engineer (React & TypeScript)
description: Looking for a passionate Senior Frontend Engineer to build high-performance web applications using React, Next.js, and TypeScript. You will own the client architecture and deliver delightful user interfaces.
responsibilities: Architect and maintain scalable React and Next.js web applications with clean TypeScript.
Develop pixel-perfect, accessible components with Tailwind CSS.
Implement state management with Redux and client-side caching strategies.
Optimize web performance, Core Web Vitals, and responsive UI across devices.
Write automated unit and integration tests with Jest and Cypress.
requirements: 4+ years of professional experience with React, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript.
Expertise in Next.js, server-side rendering, and responsive CSS frameworks.
Hands-on experience consuming REST APIs and GraphQL backends.
Strong understanding of web accessibility, cross-browser compatibility, and testing.
